comment: The distinction between HMIS operating at population level and CDSE operating at individual level is useful but incomplete. Decision support can also operate at population level, and HMIS outputs may support facility-level or individual follow-up.

public.text: The distinction between HMIS operating at population level and CDSE operating at individual level is useful but incomplete. Decision support can also operate at population level, and HMIS outputs may support facility-level or individual follow-up.
public.suggestedRevision: Present individual-versus-population level as a typical emphasis rather than a strict architectural boundary. Define components by their services and data responsibilities.
